id: title:Gilbert09:retry throttled s3 cleanup and wrap fatal errors

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient error handling and retry mechanisms to warehouse-source cleanup and warehouse query execution, potentially reducing transient failures during warehouse ingestion and cleanup.
review.reason: Adds parameterized tests for transient S3 errors and replaces a single-shot S3 delete with a retry loop, adding transient throttling handling and a maximum attempt cap; also adds a FileNotFoundError early-exit and preserves the original error-path behavior.
review.uncertainty: The exact benefit depends on the broader warehouse ingestion and cleanup behavior, and the supplied observations do not establish actual adoption or incident avoidance.
